text: Where did the gang live and train for 5 months before launching the Royal Mint heist?
funFact: The Professor rented the Toledo estate under strict rules: no personal relationships, no real names, no blood ties.

text: What terminal illness did Berlin suffer from throughout the Royal Mint heist?
funFact: Berlin knowingly sacrificed his life in the tunnel to buy time for the crew because of his terminal diagnosis.

text: What is Denver's real name and what is his family relationship to Moscow?
funFact: Moscow (Agustín Ramos) brought his son Denver into the heist to help him escape a dangerous street gang debt.

text: Which tropical island in the Philippines did the Professor tell Raquel to meet him on?
funFact: The Professor hid coordinates on postcards inside his cafe sketches for Raquel to discover.

text: What secret hobby does the Professor obsessively practice to relieve stress and plan tactical moves?
funFact: The Professor folded paper red birds with surgical precision during every tense negotiation phone call.

text: In the Bank of Spain heist, what city codename was given to Martín Berrote?
funFact: Palermo co-designed the water-pump extraction plan in Florence years before the first heist began.

text: Which hostage was shot in the thigh by Denver instead of being executed, later becoming 'Stockholm'?
funFact: Denver hid Mónica inside a vault vault chamber to protect her after refusing Berlin's execution order.

text: Who was the VIP hostage in the Royal Mint whose father was the British Ambassador to Spain?
funFact: Alison Parker was the Professor's trump card ('the lamb') that prevented police special forces from storming the mint.

text: What was the name of the ruthless Bank of Spain chief of security who fought the gang from the inside?
funFact: Gandía dislocated his thumbs to escape his handcuffs and triggered lethal guerrilla combat inside the bank.

text: How did the gang pump 90 tons of melted gold out of the flooded Bank of Spain vault?
options: As gravel slurry through Madrid stormwater drainage pipes
funFact: Industrial pumps shot the gold micro-pellets through Madrid's underground stormwater canal straight to the Stormwater Tank.

text: How did the surviving crew ultimately escape Spain at the conclusion of the Bank of Spain heist?
options: Fake zinc funeral coffins transported in a military escort
A French submarine voyage across the Mediterranean
funFact: Tamayo announced they were shot dead, while the gang was driven away in official zinc coffins into a new life!
